title: Mythara.cz
description: A Czech Vanilla Minecraft Server focused on RPG Survival, Economy Survival and RPG Oneblock with Resource Pack.
body:
## 🔮 MYTHARA.CZ
🇨🇿 Unique Czech Minecraft Server (**Java 1.21.11 + Bedrock**)

## 🛡️ OUR GAME MODES
### 🍃 CLASSIC SURVIVAL
>   🎤 Simple Voice Chat Mod Compatibility
>   
>   🌳 No overcomplicated RPG Systems and No Complicated Mechanics
>   
>   🌿 Combination of Vanilla-like Gameplay and Modern plugins
>   
>   🗺️ Using Terralith for Map generation
>   
>   🎣 Modified Fishing using **PyroFishing**
>   
>   🌾 More Farming content with **PyroMining**
>   
>   ⛏️ More Mining Related Bosses, Enchantments and more using **PyroMining**
>   
>   📜 Challenges, Quests and much more Activities for everyone
>   
>   😌 Ideal for players, that want to chill and go by their pace

### 🎉 EVENT SERVER
> 🗓️ Every **Saturday at 19:00 (CET)**!
> 
> 🏆 Play for Unique and Rare Rewards!
> 
> 🔥 Beloved Minigames re-created as Events - Survival Games, Spleef, Splegg and much more!

### 🏝️ RPG ONEBLOCK
>   🌸 Unique RPG Oneblock with Quests, New Content and Grind mechanics
>   
>   🏝️ Start with **5x5** Island and expand up to **250x250** using Economy
>   
>   🧱 Break a Magic Block and go through 40+ phases to unlock new Bosses in other Dimensions
>   
>   ⚒️ Level-up Professions and Unlock new Crafting Recipes, Items and much more
>   
>   🎣 Modified Fishing using PyroFishing and More Farming Content with PyroFarming
>   
>   🛠️ New recipes, New items, Special mechanics, Locations, Dungeons and much more

### ⚔️ RPG SURVIVAL
>   🧟 Survival Gamemode with RPG Semi-Open World with new Monsters and Quests
>   
>   👹 Challenge new Bosses in Bosslands and Dungeons
>   
>   📈 Upgrade your Characters using Attributes and Levelling
>   
>   🌍 Using Terralith for Survival Map generation
>   
>   🎣 PyroFishing + 🌾 PyroFarming + ⛏️ PyroMining
>   
>   📖 Follow the lore of World of **Denestria**
  

## 📱 START PLAYING!
>   🟩 **Java IP:** `mc.mythara.cz`
>   
>   🟦 **Bedrock IP:** `bedrock.mythara.cz` Port  `32533`

## 📚 MORE INFORMATION
>   🌐 Web: [https://mythara.cz](https://mythara.cz)
>   
>   💬 Discord: [https://discord.gg/mythara](https://discord.gg/mythara)
